description: Static AFOL-only command catalog for retained scaffold metadata.

tools.name: AFOL Status
tools.description: Show compact project and session state before governed work.

tools.name: AFOL New
tools.description: Create a governed session under .afol/wb for implementation or delivery work.

tools.name: AFOL Start
tools.description: Move a governed task to in_progress before edits.

tools.name: AFOL Evidence
tools.description: Record command evidence for a governed task.

tools.name: AFOL Done
tools.description: Mark a task complete after relevant validation and evidence.

tools.name: AFOL Close
tools.description: Close a governed session after tasks are complete.

tools.name: AFOL Verify Tasks
tools.description: Verify workbench task state and evidence consistency.

tools.name: AFOL Local State
tools.description: Rebuild local AFOL state indexes when scaffold metadata changes.

tools.name: AFOL Update
tools.description: Check scaffold updates with compact output.

execution_modes.on-demand: Run only when the active task needs the command evidence or state transition.
